messages:
emma: RCA published: autoscaler churn + cache thrash caused tail-latency spike during a scale event. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-3699
emma: Summary: during a sudden traffic surge our autoscaler rapidly cycled instances. K/V prefix caches warmed on new nodes but eviction bursts and inconsistent route pruning triggered many fallback paths, causing a tail-latency SLO burn (~90th/99th) for ~38 minutes.
emma: Immediate actions taken: paused autoscale, reverted to stable scaling policy, and forced a coordinated cache warmup for affected pools.
rohan: Thanks Emma. Can you list action items and tentative owners so we can close the loop?
emma: Action list:
- C1: Add autoscaler backoff and hysteresis to prevent rapid churn (owner: rohan)
- C2: Make cache warmup deterministic post-scale (owner: jia)
- C3: Add a fallback-rate SLO monitor + alert (owner: ben)
- C4: Document safe rollout practices for scaling policies (owner: emma)
- C5: Customer outreach template for impacted accounts (owner: ops-bot)
jia: Taking C2. Plan: preload common prefixes and delay traffic cutover until warmup completes. ETA: PR by Fri.
rohan: I'll take C1. Implementing a 2-phase scale with exponential backoff and safety thresholds. ETA: 2025-05-10.
ben: C3 here. Will add a grafana panel and a severity-3 pager for sustained fallback-rate >0.5% over 5m.
emma: For checkpoints: 1-week status: 2025-05-07, 30-day review: 2025-06-04. I'll add them to the RCA and send invites.
incident-bot: RCA RC-3699 created by emma. Title: "Autoscaler churn -> cache thrash -> tail latency" https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-3699
ops-bot: Customer outreach template prepared and linked in RCA. Will coordinate sends with Support once PRs land.
rohan: Please drop PRs here as they land. We'll track in the RCA.
jia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/811 (cache warmup + gating)
ben: Monitoring PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/438 (fallback-rate panel + alert)
rohan: Autoscaler change PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autoscaler/pull/99 (backoff + safety checks)
emma: Thanks team. 1-week checkpoint invite sent (2025-05-07 11:00 PT). If anything blocks, post here or ping me. :white_check_mark:
rohan: Will run a quick game-day to validate warmup flow before the 1-week check.
jia: I'll add regression tests that simulate rapid scale events.
ben: Noted, I'll include the new panels in the SLO digest.
emma: Closing thread for now 1 tracking continues in the RCA and PRs. Thanks all. :v:
